Half-Cell A: Strip of Cu(s) in $CuNO_3(aq)$

Half-Cell B: Strip of Zn(s) in $Zn(NO_3)_2(aq)$

When the cells are connected according to the following diagram, the following reaction occurs. How many moles of electrons must be transferred to create 127 g of copper?

method.method_draft: First describe the image and identify the overall reaction printed below the electrochemical cell. Convert 127 g Cu to moles using Cu molar mass: 127/63.5 = 2 mol Cu. From the displayed balanced reaction, 2 mol Cu(s) are produced when Zn transfers 2 mol electrons. Therefore producing 2 mol Cu requires 2 mol electrons.
